about: Planted probe set for the claim extractor (plan R12.11), written by hand for this repository, apart from the generated dev set (eval/synthetic/claims, gen.py) and in a different shape: real-looking paragraphs in Hebrew and English with prefixes, numbers written two ways, lists, quotes and mixed scripts, and model drafts that fail the way a small local model fails (a changed number, a flipped negation, a swapped entity that the paragraph does name elsewhere, two sentences merged, a hedged sentence turned into a fact, a pronoun left unresolved). Every name is invented. Labels: keep = a faithful, checkable claim that should survive; every other label is a draft that should be dropped, with the failure it plants. Same author as the rules, so its numbers are development numbers, not a held-out score. Licence CC0-1.0.
